title: Google search interest
subtitle: Relative search interest, 100 = the highest point of any compared term in the window
takeaway: Awaiting data: Google Trends has no public API, so this needs a SerpAPI key (SERPAPI_KEY in .env; the free plan is enough).
assumptions: Google Trends is relative: 100 is the peak of the most-searched term in the 5-year window, and every other value is a share of it.
Terms compared: Claude AI, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Grok AI, Mistral AI. Cohere is left out (Trends compares at most five).
Shown as monthly averages of weekly values, from the newest run only, because each run rescales to its own window.
Needs a SerpAPI key; without one this chart is empty.

sources.label: Google Trends via SerpAPI (interest over time)
